story: I booked a flight on Air India, they cancelled it and haven't returned my money for 3 months
IndiGo cancelled my flight during the lockdown and only gave me a credit shell instead of cash back
airline refused to let me board even though I had a confirmed ticket, they said the flight was overbooked
my checked-in bag was lost by the airline and they are offering only a tiny amount
my flight was delayed 9 hours, I missed my connection and got no compensation or food
MakeMyTrip charged me cancellation fees even though the airline itself cancelled the flight
travel agent took money for a foreign tour package and then cancelled with no refund
I booked tickets online, the payment was deducted but no ticket was generated and no refund came
airline charged me extra at the airport for baggage that was within the allowed limit
I cancelled my ticket two days before travel because I was ill and the airline kept the whole fare
SpiceJet cancelled my flight and put me on another one two days later without asking me
my international flight was cancelled and the airline refused a refund saying it was a non refundable ticket
the airline damaged my luggage and refused to pay anything for it
my visa was rejected and the travel agent refuses to refund the tour package booking
Jet Airways stopped flying and I never got my ticket money back
I booked a flight and hotel package online, the service was poor and they cancelled part of it
a passenger on a wheelchair was mistreated and humiliated by airline staff at the airport
the ticket fare was shown wrong, and the airline cancelled my booking after I had paid the lower price
airline refused to refund the airport taxes on my unused ticket
the tour operator did not provide the hotel and sightseeing promised in our holiday package
my cruise booking was cancelled by the company and they will not return the advance
the airline changed its schedule so I had to cancel my trip, and they refused to refund me
a foreign airline denied me boarding saying my passport had issues and kept my money
I paid extra for a better seat but was given a regular seat on the flight
the flight was delayed so long that I lost my hotel booking and prepaid car rental
a medical emergency forced me to cancel and the travel agent charged me heavy cancellation fees
the airline lost my parcel which I had sent as cargo and now denies responsibility
I cancelled within a day of booking but the airline did not give me a full refund
I booked tickets for my family of five, the flight was cancelled and they refunded only two tickets
I want compensation from the airline for harassment and mental agony caused by deficiency in service
